description: Context rules for official public-sector apps that mainly publish public records, agendas, decisions, or civic information.

effect.appProfileImpact: Public-sector apps may publish public records, but an exported provider still needs an intentional public contract. Verify it cannot expose local cache, identifiers, preferences, or non-public state.
For public-sector information apps, exported services or receivers are usually review items unless they process private user data, authentication, payments, or privileged device actions.
The profile says external integrations are not expected. In an official public-sector app, third-party SDKs deserve explicit justification, privacy review, and disclosure.
Public-sector apps should be conservative with third-party SDKs. Confirm necessity, data sharing, legal basis, and disclosure even when the content itself is public.
For public-sector information apps without login or payments, backup is normally a review item, not an automatic blocker. Confirm that only public cache or harmless preferences are stored.
